verdict.rationale: Open-source license compliance counsel is a fair question for an IP and tech law firm, so the axis applies. The pack covers patents, trade marks, IP litigation and tech transactions, but no item names open-source licensing, OSS compliance or OSS usage policy advice as a capability. Adjacent IP and tech-deal practices do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability
